notes.6: PR #6 squash-merged as a763cf3e. 22/22 phase-6 tests (1 xfail for missing STRIPE_TEST_SECRET_KEY) + 75/75 regression = 97/97 green. billing.py ledger (trial $20/90d, cap_soft $80, cap_hard $100, session_ceiling $5 — all configurable in tenants/<t>/config.json billing block + DB overrides). check_eligibility() gates legacy + tenant-prefixed session create AND message send with HTTP 402 (hard_cap_exceeded or insufficient_balance). Soft-threshold watermark — one billing.threshold SSE event per crossing, resets when MTD drops. Stripe Checkout + customer portal + signature-verified webhook (lazy stripe import, 503 when key absent — no mocks). /api/platform/billing/credit idempotent on (tenant, reference). BillingDrawer frontend with owner/viewer split: balance, trial, MTD, cap progress bars, soft-cap editor, Stripe top-up + portal, manual-pay contact block, usage + transactions tabs. Per-session cost counter ($X · Model badge) in ChatPanel toolbar — refreshes after each turn via /api/sessions/{sid}/cost. useAgentStream surfaces 402 responses as billing.cap_exceeded events; ChatPanel renders billing.threshold + billing.cap_exceeded as amber/red banners. Live smoke verified: cap_hard=$0.10 produces 402 on session create; $50 manual credit landed instantly on $20-trial tenant for $70 balance.
notes.7: PR #7 squash-merged as e781f7d5. 25/25 phase-7 tests + 97/97 regression = 122/122 green (+ 1 xfail Stripe live). Backend: design-system module (palette/typography/spec.md, atomic per-slice writes, partial PUT preserves siblings, 400/422 on bad shape); shared-assets module (25 MB cap, extension denylist .exe/.js/.html/.py/.sh/…, path-escape guard via Path.resolve().relative_to(base), prunes empty parents on delete). 6 new routes on /api/tenants/{slug}/{design-system,shared,shared/file,templates/{name}/file,projects/from-template}. RBAC matrix: design-system owner-only write / viewer read, shared upload+delete editor+/viewer read+fetch, template-file viewer, from-template editor. Frontend: useTenants hook (Me + TenantSummary, localStorage awesomedeck.activeTenant, revoked-slug fallback to first available). TenantSwitcher (sidebar dropdown, click-outside-to-close, empty-state pill). TenantSettingsDrawer with Members/Design/Shared tabs + read-only chip for non-owners. Dashboard tenant-scoped: templates list, thumbnail fetch, from-template create, project list — all pivot off activeSlug. App.switchTenant calls exitSession() before setActiveSlug (§10.2). Frontend interactive flows code-only-verified — backend coverage exhaustive, vite build 423.96 kB clean.
notes.8: PR #8 squash-merged as beaa81d0. 28/28 phase-8 tests + 122/122 regression = 150/150 green (+ 1 xfail Stripe live). Backend: tenants.read_project_meta + add_project_share_user / add_project_share_tenant / remove_project_share — atomic .project.json writes; authz.resolve_project_role now reads via tenants helpers + new require_project_role dependency walks §6.2 chain (platform_admin → home-tenant role → user ACL → tenant grant capped at editor → 403). All project-scoped tenant routes (slides/exports/recent/tree/file/output-dirs.get/.put/.register/images.generate) moved from require_tenant_role to require_project_role. sessions/attach resolves via project role too (editor cap). 3 new endpoints: GET/POST /api/tenants/{slug}/projects/{name}/share (POST body: {user_id|email|tenant_slug, role}; email resolved to user_id; tenant_slug validated, self-tenant rejected 400; idempotent role replace) + DELETE /api/tenants/{slug}/projects/{name}/share/{principal} where principal is `user:<id>` or `tenant:<slug>`. Frontend: ShareDialog component (current grants list, add-by-email | add-by-tenant-slug form, owner-only writes, viewer can still see list). ProjectHeader gets Share button between History and Billing. App.tsx threads session.tenant_slug + computes canManageShares from me.platform_admin || home-tenant owner. vite build clean (430 kB / 126.81 kB gzip).
